name: SuRFNet
definition: A 3D pipeline that distills image views into partial 3D SRFs and learns in the 3D sparse voxel space to generate full SRFs based on the partial SRFs. It uses MinkowskiNet as the 3D sparse convolution network.
summary: SuRFNet is a 3D pipeline that generates full Sparse Radiance Fields from partial inputs using 3D sparse convolutions, ensuring multi-view consistency unlike 2D prior-based methods.
